lines.en: label beachsix1:
scene sky

And so the time has come again to watch girls take their clothes off — just in the acceptable sort of way that you can only get in trouble for if you’re caught staring for longer than two seconds at a time.
lines.zh: 于是，又到了看女孩们脱衣服的时候了——只不过是以那种「可接受」的方式：只有当你在同一处盯着看超过两秒、还被抓到的时候，才会惹上麻烦。

lines.en: It’s fine in small doses, I think. Like Xanax or ice cream or anything else that helps you feel a certain way when the way you’re {i}currently{/i} feeling has been labeled “wrong” by a team of psychologists.
lines.zh: 我觉得小剂量是没问题的。就像 Xanax、冰淇淋，或者别的东西——当你{i}当下{/i}的感受被一群心理学家贴上「错误」的标签时，能让你产生某种感受的东西。

lines.en: What do they know, though? They haven’t seen the world I’ve seen.
lines.zh: 不过他们懂什么呢？他们又没见过我见过的世界。

lines.en: And you haven’t either. Because chances are, you think I’m someone I’m not. Which you might actually be right about in a weird, roundabout way. I have a hard time keeping track of that too.
lines.zh: 你也没有。因为很可能，你以为我是某个我不是的人。而这事你有可能是对的，以一种诡异、绕弯的方式。我自己也很难搞清。

lines.en: Either way, the point is, my world is different from this one. But {i}my{/i} world is always changing and {i}your{/i} world stays the same.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，重点是，我的世界和这个世界不同。但{i}我的{/i}世界一直在变，而{i}你的{/i}世界一成不变。

lines.en: It stays {i}painfully{/i} the same. Its bones can break and bend and its roots can sprawl out well beyond the confines of its forced perimeter, but it’s still Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: 它{i}痛苦地{/i}一成不变。它的骨头可以折断、可以弯曲，它的根可以蔓延到远远超出那道被强加的边界之外，但它依然是 Kumon-mi。

lines.en: And you’re still a disembodied set of ears and eyes while {i}I{/i} am but the voice. So together, we almost make a face!
lines.zh: 而你依然是一双没有身体的耳朵和眼睛，而{i}我{/i}不过是个声音。所以我们俩凑在一起，几乎就凑成了一张脸！

lines.en: A happy face — one that smiles from ear (yours) to ear (also yours) and neglects to ever remember how sad this story really is.
lines.zh: 一张快乐的脸——从一只耳朵（你的）笑到另一只耳朵（也是你的），并且永远不会记得这个故事到底有多悲伤。

lines.en: Because every second spent {i}here{/i} is like a forced vacation away from where you really {i}want{/i} to be.
lines.zh: 因为在这里度过的每一秒，都像是被迫离开你真正{i}想{/i}待的地方去度假。

lines.en: {i}My{/i} world. {i}My{/i} house. Where you’re seated at the table for a fancy dinner with your significant other, prepared and plated by an angel of {i}your{/i} creation.
lines.zh: {i}我的{/i}世界。{i}我的{/i}房子。在那里，你和你重要的另一半坐在餐桌前享用一顿精致的晚餐，由一个出自{i}你{/i}之手的天使准备并装盘。

lines.en: Heaven isn’t real. At least not in the way you think. But if it was, I bet you imagine it’d be something like that.
lines.zh: 天堂不是真的。至少不是你所想的那种。但如果它是，我猜你会把它想象成那个样子。

lines.en: And hey! Maybe you’re right, maybe you’re wrong. One of us would need to die to find out and it sure as heck ain’t gonna be me!
lines.zh: 而且嘿！也许你是对的，也许你是错的。我们得有一个人死掉才能知道，而那肯定不会是我！

lines.en: Please don’t let it be you either, though.
lines.zh: 不过也请别是你。

lines.en: Please?
lines.zh: 求你了？

lines.en: Anyway! Sorry for keeping you. Just wanted to drop in before everything goes to Hell. (Which is real, by the way. But again, not in the way you think.)
lines.zh: 总之！抱歉耽误你了。只是想在一切坠入地狱之前过来打个招呼。（地狱是真的，顺便说一句。但同样，不是你所想的那种。）

lines.en: Maybe I’ll see you soon, I wonder?
lines.zh: 也许我很快就会见到你，我猜？

lines.en: I hope I see you soon.
lines.zh: 我希望很快能见到你。

lines.en: scene onabus1
Anyway! Bus!
lines.zh: 总之！公交车！

lines.en: : Before I begin, I would like to say thank you to Molly for letting an unpleasant, three-legged centipede like me be the new dragon master.
lines.zh: 在开始之前，我想感谢 Molly 让一只像我这样讨人厌的三腿蜈蚣成为新的龙王。

lines.en: : {i}Dungeon{/i} master. And it’s really no-
lines.zh: {i}地下城{/i}城主。而且真的不用-

lines.en: scene onabus2
: Adventure start! Where are you?
lines.zh: 冒险开始！你们在哪里？

lines.en: scene onabus3
: You don’t know?!
lines.zh: 你不知道？！

lines.en: : I believe we are on a bus.
lines.zh: 我相信我们在一辆公交车上。

lines.en: : Ding ding! Tsuneyo gets a point!
lines.zh: 叮叮！Tsuneyo 得一分！

lines.en: : Of what?!
lines.zh: 什么的分数？！

lines.en: : Damage against the boss you’re fighting.
lines.zh: 对你们正在打的 boss 造成的伤害。

lines.en: : How does identifying where we are currently located damage the boss?! Who {i}is{/i} the boss?! And are we {i}actually{/i} on a bus or is this just a parody of something significantly funnier?!
lines.zh: 认出我们当前所处的位置，怎么会对 boss 造成伤害？！到底谁{i}是{/i}那个 boss？！我们{i}真的{/i}在一辆公交车上吗，还是这只是对某个好笑得多的东西的恶搞？！

lines.en: : Just let Yasu do things her way, Molly. I’m sure that at least one of our many questions will be answered by the end of this bus ride.
lines.zh: 就让 Yasu 按她自己的方式来吧，Molly。我相信我们这一大堆问题里，至少有一个会在这趟公交车行程结束前得到解答。

lines.en: : I hope it never ends. I am finally winning at this game.
lines.zh: 我希望它永远不要结束。我终于在这个游戏里赢了。

lines.en: scene onabus4
: The real surprise here is that Molly didn’t immediately recognize this skit as a Dropout reference.
lines.zh: 这里真正让人意外的是，Molly 居然没立刻认出这段短剧是在致敬 Dropout。

lines.en: : Ding ding! Rin gets a point too! The boss is defeated!
lines.zh: 叮叮！Rin 也得分！boss 被击败了！

lines.en: scene onabus5
: Fuck yeah! Combat is so easy when I don’t have to roll!
lines.zh: 操，太爽了！不用掷骰子的战斗也太简单了！

lines.en: : Why did the boss only have 2 HP?! And how did Rin {i}also{/i} recognizing something manage to kill it?!
lines.zh: 为什么 boss 只有 2 点血？！还有 Rin {i}也{/i}认出了什么东西这件事，怎么能杀死它？！

lines.en: : She’s obviously just really good at this game. Duh.
lines.zh: 她显然就是很擅长这个游戏。废话。

lines.en: scene onabus6
: Me? Absolutely not. I’m not really good at anything. Unless you count not being good at stuff. I’m {i}really{/i} good at not being good at stuff.
lines.zh: 我吗？绝对不是。我什么都不擅长。除非「不擅长」也算擅长。我{i}非常{/i}擅长不擅长。

lines.en: : You’re really good at being cute too.
lines.zh: 你也很擅长可爱。

lines.en: scene onabus7
: I’m confused. Are those two gay now? Because they seem gay now.
lines.zh: 我糊涂了。她俩现在是同性恋了吗？因为看起来像是了。

lines.en: : Rin’s always been half-gay. Chika’s probably just worn down by the fact that everyone else likes Sensei and sees now as a good time to experiment.
lines.zh: Rin 一直都是半个同性恋。Chika 大概只是被「其他所有人都喜欢 Sensei」这件事磨得没脾气了，觉得现在是时候试试看。

lines.en: : On the bus?...I feel like that’s illegal...
lines.zh: 在公交车上？……我觉得那是违法的……

lines.en: scene onabus8
: It is. Sexual content is prohibited and has resulted in Rin’s death.
lines.zh: 是的。禁止含有性内容，Rin 因此死亡。

lines.en: : But we haven’t even done anything!
lines.zh: 可我们什么都还没做啊！

lines.en: : {i}{size=-10}I mean...{/i}{/size}
lines.zh: {i}{size=-10}我是说……{/i}{/size}

lines.en: : {i}{size=-10}Shh!{/i}{/size}
lines.zh: {i}{size=-10}嘘！{/i}{/size}

lines.en: scene onabus9
: Rin, please roll to stay alive.
lines.zh: Rin，请掷骰活下来。

lines.en: : Roll what? Which die? Or...dice? What am I rolling, exactly?
lines.zh: 掷什么？哪个骰子？还是……骰子们？我到底要掷什么？

lines.en: : The big one with the most numbers.
lines.zh: 那个数字最多的、最大的。

lines.en: : Oh, fuck yeah. I never get to use my d100. The chances of me rolling a 5 are so much lower now!
lines.zh: 哦，操，太棒了。我从来没机会用我的 d100。我现在掷出 5 的概率低太多了！

lines.en: : We all know you’re going to roll one anyway, so just get it out of the way now.
lines.zh: 我们都知道你反正会掷出 1，所以现在就赶紧投了吧。

lines.en: : Joke’s on you Futaba! That’s...a 25! My highest roll ever!
lines.zh: 你失算了，Futaba！是……25！我有史以来最高的掷骰！

lines.en: : That’s basically just a 5 on a d100, isn’t it? Because 20 divided by 5 is 4, same as 100 divided by 25. That’s essentially a 25%% roll if you convert those numbers to percentages.
lines.zh: 那基本就相当于 d100 上的 5，不是吗？因为 20 除以 5 等于 4，跟 100 除以 25 一样。如果把这些数字换算成百分比，那基本上就是 25%% 的骰。

lines.en: : Did you really have to wait until right this moment to learn math, Ami?! What happens, Yasu?! Do I live?
lines.zh: 你非得等到这一刻才学会数学吗，Ami？！怎么样，Yasu？！我活下来了吗？

lines.en: scene onabus10
: Sorry, no. You needed to roll a 5 to live. Rolling a 25 has popped one of the tires on the bus. Now you must go on a quest to fix it.
lines.zh: 抱歉，没有。你需要掷出 5 才能活。掷出 25 让公交车爆了一个胎。现在你必须踏上修胎的任务。

lines.en: : Where’s this bus even going, Yasuyasu? And how come there are a bunch of medieval adventurer thingies on it?
lines.zh: 这辆公交车到底要去哪儿啊，Yasuyasu？还有为什么上面有一堆中世纪冒险者之类的东西？

lines.en: scene onabus11
: Sana — roll for initiative.
lines.zh: Sana——掷先攻。

lines.en: : Huh?...What?...Me? Why? Who am I fighting?
lines.zh: 啊？……什么？……我？为什么？我在跟谁打？

lines.en: : Thaum. He is on the bus today too. He’s on the way to work.
lines.zh: Thaum。他今天也在公交车上。他正在去上班的路上。

lines.en: scene onabus12
: Thaum doesn’t ride the {i}bus{/i} to work! Buses don’t go to the Underdark! Nor do they even {i}exist{/i} in our campaign! Do not desecrate my final boss in such a pitiful manner!
lines.zh: Thaum 才不会{i}坐公交车{/i}去上班！公交车不开往幽暗地域！而且它们在我们这场战役里甚至{i}根本不存在{/i}！别用这么可悲的方式亵渎我的最终 boss！

lines.en: : I rolled a...oh! Natural 20.
lines.zh: 我掷出了……哦！天然 20。

lines.en: : Thaum is dead!
lines.zh: Thaum 死了！

lines.en: scene onabus13
: No! He needs to die in a very specific way! He can’t be murdered on a bus he wasn’t even supposed to be on in the first place!
lines.zh: 不！他必须以一种非常特定的方式死去！他不能死在一辆他本来就不该出现的公交车上！

lines.en: : What an inconvenient time to learn how dangerous public transportation can be. Especially for those who can not identify it.
lines.zh: 在这么不方便的时候了解到公共交通有多危险。尤其是对那些认不出它的人来说。

lines.en: : So is our campaign just over now? Thaum is the final boss, right?
lines.zh: 那我们的战役就这么结束了吗？Thaum 是最终 boss，对吧？

lines.en: : No, now you have to change the tire. Everyone roll! The highest roll inherits Thaum’s job at the supermarket.
lines.zh: 不，现在你们得换轮胎。所有人掷骰！最高的人继承 Thaum 在超市的工作。

lines.en: scene onabus14
: Oh. Well I guess that’s that for {i}that{/i} campaign then. I wonder what Molly will plan next?
lines.zh: 哦。那我想{i}那场{/i}战役就这么着了。不知道 Molly 接下来会策划什么？

lines.en: : Today doesn’t count! It’s just a...dreamy...side story thing! I assumed Yasu would do better than this with the power I bestowed unto her!
lines.zh: 今天不算！这只是个……梦一般的……外传性质的东西！我还以为 Yasu 获得我赐予的力量之后会表现得更好呢！

lines.en: : {i}Why?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}为什么？{/i}

lines.en: : Yeah. I think that one’s on you, Molly.
lines.zh: 对啊。我觉得这次是你的问题，Molly。

lines.en: : Well, {i}I{/i} think Yasuyasu did a {i}great{/i} job! Come here, you!
lines.zh: 至于{i}我{/i}，我觉得 Yasuyasu 干得{i}非常棒{/i}！过来，你！

lines.en: : Ah! S-Stop! U-Uta! I’m...ticklish there!
lines.zh: 啊！住、住手！U、Uta！我……那里怕痒！

lines.en: : So is just {i}everybody{/i} gay now or what?
lines.zh: 所以现在是{i}所有人{/i}都同性恋了还是怎样？

lines.en: : Pretty much...Everyone but you and Ayane at least...
lines.zh: 差不多……至少除了你和 Ayane 之外……

lines.en: scene onabus15
: Come to think of it, where {i}is{/i} Ayane? Have you talked to her today?
lines.zh: 这么一想，Ayane {i}在{/i}哪儿？你今天跟她说过话吗？

lines.en: : Me? No. I was too busy trying to oversleep so I wouldn’t have to come to the beach this year. Then {i}you{/i} had to go and ruin everything, so thanks for that.
lines.zh: 我？没有。我忙着睡过头，好让自己今年不用去海滩。结果{i}你{/i}非要去把一切都搞砸，所以谢了啊。

lines.en: : Yeah, no problem. Do you think Sensei’s coming too?
lines.zh: 嗯，不客气。你觉得 Sensei 也会来吗？

lines.en: scene onabus16
: Maybe. Why? Are you done guilting him into thinking he somehow managed to ruin your relationship? Do I get the room to myself again?
lines.zh: 也许吧。怎么？你已经成功让他内疚到以为自己以某种方式毁了你们的关系了？那房间又能归我一个人了？

lines.en: : That’s not it at all. I just-
lines.zh: 完全不是那么回事。我只是-

lines.en: : Ayane’s {i}with{/i} Sensei right now. They’re coming together.
lines.zh: Ayane 现在{i}和{/i} Sensei 在一起。他们一起过来。

lines.en: scene onabus17
: To...the {i}beach{/i} I mean...
lines.zh: 我是说来……{i}海滩{/i}……

lines.en: : But I wouldn’t be surprised if they were coming together in...{i}other{/i} ways too.
lines.zh: 不过要是他们在别的{i}方面{/i}也一起，我也不会惊讶。

lines.en: : Thanks for that, lewd Sana.
lines.zh: 谢了啊，好色的 Sana。

lines.en: : Yeah. We’re all so happy you’re like this now and definitely wouldn’t have thought of that on our own.
lines.zh: 是啊。我们真高兴你现在变成这样了，而且我们绝对不会自己想到那一层。

lines.en: : I hope...he saves some for me...
lines.zh: 我希望……他能给我留一点……

lines.en: scene onabus18
: Can you just shut up already?!
lines.zh: 你能不能闭嘴啊？！

lines.en: scene onabus19
: {b}THANKS AGAIN FOR DRIVING, GEOFFREY! I REALLY APPRECIATE IT!{/b}
lines.zh: {b}再次感谢你开车，GEOFFREY！我真的很感激！{/b}

lines.en: : Ayane, why are you screaming at your butler? He’s literally right there.
lines.zh: Ayane，你为什么冲着你的管家喊？他就坐在那儿啊。

lines.en: scene onabus20
: Oh, did I forget to tell you? Geoffrey’s hearing is all messed up right now after rescuing a bunch of orphans from a minefield. He nearly lost his arm when one went off right next to him!
lines.zh: 哦，我忘了告诉你？Geoffrey 的听力现在全坏了，因为他从雷区里救了一群孤儿。有一颗地雷就在他旁边炸开，他差点没了一条胳膊！

lines.en: : Am I...allowed to ask why a bunch of orphans found themselves in a minefield?
lines.zh: 我……可以问为什么一群孤儿会出现在雷区里吗？

lines.en: scene onabus21
: {b}GEOFFREY! CAN YOU TELL SENSEI WHAT ALL THOSE ORPHANS WERE DOING IN A MINEFIELD?!{/b}
lines.zh: {b}GEOFFREY！你能告诉 SENSEI 那些孤儿在雷区里干什么吗？！{/b}

lines.en: scene onabus22
: No luck. Guess you’ll just have to find out some other day.
lines.zh: 没辙。看来你只能改天再知道了。

lines.en: : That’s fine. I’m still just glad he is a real person and not an imaginary friend you made up to cope with your dad forgetting about you.
lines.zh: 没关系。我还是很高兴他是个真人，不是你为了应付你爸忘了你而编出来的假想朋友。

lines.en: scene onabus23
: Ha! As if! Who even {i}needs{/i} a regular dad when you can just borrow your friend’s and have {i}that{/i} one double as a lover?
lines.zh: 哈！说得好像！谁还{i}需要{/i}一个普通的爸爸啊，直接借你朋友的爸爸，再让{i}那一位{/i}顺便兼职当情人不就好了？

lines.en: : Maybe...{i}don’t{/i} yell that in front of a guy who’s immune to land mines and has been effectively taking care of you for years?
lines.zh: 也许……{i}别{/i}在一个对地雷免疫、而且实打实照顾了你这么多年的人面前喊这种话？

lines.en: scene onabus24
: It’s fine, Sensei. He can’t hear us. But even if he {i}could,{/i} he already knows how I feel about you. I tell Geoffrey everything.
lines.zh: 没事的，Sensei。他听不见我们。不过就算他{i}听得见{/i}，他也已经知道我对你的感觉了。我什么都跟 Geoffrey 说。

lines.en: : Not...{i}everything,{/i} I hope.
lines.zh: 希望不是{i}全部{/i}。

lines.en: : Everything. But don’t worry, I leave out all of the most {i}specific{/i} details. Those are for us and us only.
lines.zh: 全部。不过别担心，我会略过所有最{i}具体{/i}的细节。那些是只属于我们俩的。

lines.en: : And also sometimes Sana. Which I am now unfortunate enough to have to hear from {i}her{/i} as well. This is my penance for being so excited about my endlessly overflowing love for you.
lines.zh: 还有有时候也会告诉 Sana。而我现在又不幸地得从{i}她{/i}那儿也听一遍。这就是我为自己对你那满溢而出的爱如此兴奋所受到的惩罚。

lines.en: : So, you’re telling me this guy sitting in front of us is acutely aware that I am ejaculating inside of you on a regular basis?
lines.zh: 所以你是说，坐在我们前面这位老兄清楚地知道我经常在你体内射精？

lines.en: scene onabus25
: Well, you don’t have to make it {i}weird.{/i}
lines.zh: 嗯，你也不用说得这么{i}奇怪{/i}。

lines.en: : {i}You’re{/i} the one who made it weird by telling your butler. What if he told someone?
lines.zh: {i}你{/i}才是把这事变奇怪的那个，谁叫你告诉你的管家。万一他告诉别人了呢？

lines.en: : He wouldn’t. Geoffrey’s sworn an oath of loyalty to me.
lines.zh: 他不会的。Geoffrey 向我宣过效忠誓。

lines.en: : And he’s so serious about it that he refuses to even leave the house without his dynamite vest that’s set to detonate the moment he ever lets me down.
lines.zh: 而且他认真到什么程度呢——只要出门，他就一定要穿上那件炸药背心，一旦他让我失望，它就会立刻引爆。
他在……

lines.en: : Wearing a dynamite vest, yeah.
lines.zh: 穿着炸药背心，对。

lines.en: scene onabus26
: It’s nothing to worry about, though. Geoffrey doesn’t have a problem with us either way because he knows how happy you make me.
lines.zh: 不过没什么好担心的。Geoffrey 对我们也没有意见，因为他知道你让我有多幸福。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m a bit more worried about the dynamite at the moment.
lines.zh: 嗯，我现在更担心的是那件炸药。

lines.en: : If we die, at least we’ll die together.
lines.zh: 如果我们死了，至少我们死在一起。

lines.en: : Not helping.
lines.zh: 这话没用。

lines.en: scene onabus27
: You know what {i}will{/i} help, though?
lines.zh: 不过你知道什么{i}才{/i}有用吗？

lines.en: : Another slumber party?
lines.zh: 再办一次睡衣派对？

lines.en: : Nope! {i}I’m{/i} talking about another slumber-
lines.zh: 不！{i}我{/i}说的是再办一次睡衣-

lines.en: scene onabus28
: Wait! Why do you know already? That was supposed to be a surprise!
lines.zh: 等等！你怎么已经知道了？那本来该是个惊喜的！

lines.en: : Probably because you {i}always{/i} leverage the apocalypse to turn group outings into slumber parties to make sure you sleep in the same room as me.
lines.zh: 大概是因为你{i}总是{/i}拿世界末日当筹码，把集体出游变成睡衣派对，好确保你能跟我睡在同一个房间。

lines.en: scene onabus29
: Sleeping in the same room as you is just an added benefit. What I {i}really{/i} love is friendship. And pajamas. So slumber parties are obviously the way to go.
lines.zh: 能跟你睡在同一个房间只是附带的福利。我{i}真正{/i}爱的是友谊。还有睡衣。所以睡衣派对显然是不二之选。

lines.en: scene onabus30
: Unfortunately, the main issue with {i}that{/i} is that our pre-apocalypse slumber parties have pretty much all led to dead ends.
lines.zh: 不幸的是，{i}这{/i}个做法的主要问题是，我们那些末日前的睡衣派对基本都以死胡同收场。

lines.en: : And seeing as Makoto {i}still{/i} refuses to weigh in on what we should do next, I’m more or less just trying to establish a routine where-
lines.zh: 而且既然 Makoto {i}依然{/i}不肯就我们下一步该怎么办表态，我差不多只是在努力建立一种日常，好让-

lines.en: : Makoto has some ideas of her own.
lines.zh: Makoto 有自己的一些想法。

lines.en: scene onabus31
: Huh?
lines.zh: 啊？

lines.en: : They’re not really {i}good{/i} ones, though. At least I don’t think so. But I’m surprised she hasn’t told you.
lines.zh: 不过那些想法算不上{i}好{/i}。至少我不这么认为。但我很惊讶她没告诉你。

lines.en: : Can...{i}you{/i} tell me? Because I was pretty confident she just decided to blow me off after our secret lesbian meeting came to an end.
lines.zh: {i}你{/i}能告诉我吗？因为我挺确信的，在我们那场秘密女同会议结束之后，她就决定把我给打发了。

lines.en: : Yeah, I- your what?
lines.zh: 嗯，我——你的什么？

lines.en: : Our secret meeting.
lines.zh: 我们的秘密会议。

lines.en: : Secret...{i}what{/i} meeting?
lines.zh: 秘密……{i}什么{/i}会议？

lines.en: scene onabus32
: You’ll just have to ask Miss Imai. She’s the one who found Makoto on top of me after all. My memory’s getting kind of hazy with all these resets.
lines.zh: 你得去问 Imai 老师。毕竟是她发现 Makoto 压在我身上的。经历了这么多次重置，我的记忆有点模糊了。

lines.en: : Ayane — did you become bisexual without asking me first?
lines.zh: Ayane——你是在没先问过我的情况下变成双性恋的吗？

lines.en: scene onabus33
: Ugh...{i}no.{/i} I {i}wish.{/i} You’d like me so much more if I joined you in your escapades of conquering my entire friend group.
lines.zh: 呃……{i}没有{/i}。我倒是{i}希望{/i}是。要是我能加入你、一起征服我整个朋友圈，你会更喜欢我的。

lines.en: : Incorrect. There is nothing that can make me like you any more than I already do. But, getting back to the matter at hand-
lines.zh: 不对。没有任何东西能让我比现在更喜欢你。不过，回到正题-

lines.en: scene onabus34
: Don’t get back to the matter at hand! I want to hear more about how much you like me!
lines.zh: 别回到正题！我想多听你说你有多喜欢我！

lines.en: scene onabus33
: {i}Getting back to the matter at hand...{/i}Makoto’s ideas can be boiled down to two things at the moment.
lines.zh: {i}回到正题……{/i}Makoto 的想法目前可以归结为两件事。

lines.en: scene onabus35
: The first is that routine is the {i}opposite{/i} of what we should be going for right now. And that being {i}less{/i} predictable might help us out of this mess if we’re...good enough at it.
lines.zh: 第一，日常正是我们现在{i}不该{/i}追求的东西。而如果我们……足够擅长的话，{i}少{/i}一点可预测性，也许能帮我们走出这团乱麻。

lines.en: : Well...that one’s not so bad, right? Because Maya was {i}extremely{/i} predictable and she never got anywhere. It took {i}you{/i} showing up to move things forward.
lines.zh: 嗯……那条倒也不算太糟，对吧？因为 Maya {i}极其{/i}可预测，却哪儿也没走到。最后是{i}你{/i}出现才推动了事情。

lines.en: : And with Yumi now being a part of the team, things are kind of {i}still{/i} moving forward.
lines.zh: 而现在 Yumi 也加入了队伍，事情{i}依然{/i}在往前推进。

lines.en: : So maybe if we just...figure out how to maintain this pace, we’ll {i}all{/i} eventually be aware of the loops?
lines.zh: 所以也许只要我们……搞清楚怎么维持这个节奏，我们{i}所有人{/i}最终都会意识到这些循环？

lines.en: : Maybe. And I’m fine with that if you are. I don’t see any need to rush when we have literally {i}all{/i} of the time in the world. But there’s another thing. A more...{i}interesting{/i} thing.
lines.zh: 也许吧。如果你没意见，我也没意见。当我们拥有世上{i}所有{/i}的时间时，我看不出有什么好急的。但还有另一件事。一件更……{i}有趣{/i}的事。

lines.en: : I don’t really like the way you said “interesting” there.
lines.zh: 我不太喜欢你说「有趣」时的语气。

lines.en: : Makoto wants to get Maya involved again.
lines.zh: Makoto 想让 Maya 重新参与进来。

lines.en: scene onabus36
: That’s all you have to add?
lines.zh: 你就只有这些要补充的？

lines.en: : Well, let me ask you this — how do {i}you{/i} feel about getting Maya involved again? {i}You’re{/i} the one who’s getting close to her all over. She’s mostly just mean to me.
lines.zh: 那么，我问你——{i}你{/i}对让 Maya 重新参与进来是什么感觉？到处跟她亲近的是{i}你{/i}。她对我基本只有刻薄。

lines.en: : I...am not a fan of the risks involved. And, to be completely transparent, I’m not sure how I’d handle it if I were to break her {i}again.{/i}
lines.zh: 我……不太喜欢其中的风险。而且，完全坦白地说，如果我又一次{i}伤{/i}了她，我不确定自己能不能承受。

lines.en: : But Makoto thinks her ability to sense when the resets are coming could be beneficial when it comes to...well, coordinating future slumber parties, for lack of a better term.
lines.zh: 但 Makoto 认为，她那种预感到重置将至的能力，在……嗯，协调未来的睡衣派对这方面可能会有帮助，找不到更好的说法了。

lines.en: : Is...something wrong? Or are you just thinking?
lines.zh: 是……有什么不对吗？还是你只是在想事情？

lines.en: : Nothing’s {i}wrong,{/i} per se. Just...
lines.zh: 严格来说没什么{i}不对{/i}。只是……

lines.en: : Hasn’t she seemed weird to you, lately? Specifically her {i}and{/i} Ami. Together. As a unit.
lines.zh: 她最近有没有让你觉得很奇怪？具体来说是她{i}和{/i} Ami。在一起。作为一个组合。

lines.en: : Uhh...well...I haven’t really seen Ami lately, so-
lines.zh: 呃……嗯……我最近真的没怎么见到 Ami，所以-

lines.en: scene onabus37
: It’s...{i}probably{/i} nothing. I just...have a hard time sort of...trusting either one of them right now. And I don’t want to accidentally ruin everything.
lines.zh: 那……{i}大概{/i}没什么。我只是……现在很难……信任她们中的任何一个。而且我不想不小心把一切都搞砸。

lines.en: : You know full well how adamant {i}our{/i} Maya was about keeping Ami out of this. And since we never really learned {i}why,{/i} it’s hard to instruct {i}this{/i} Maya to do the same.
lines.zh: 你很清楚{i}我们的{/i}那个 Maya 有多坚决要把 Ami 排除在外。而我们始终没搞清楚{i}为什么{/i}，所以很难指示{i}这个{/i} Maya 也照做。

lines.en: : Which makes me think...if Ami has somehow gotten to her before {i}us,{/i} and {i}Ami{/i} is somehow a part of this-
lines.zh: 这让我觉得……如果 Ami 以某种方式比{i}我们{/i}先接触到她，而{i}Ami{/i}又以某种方式参与其中-

lines.en: : Ami’s not a part of this, Ayane. She never has been.
lines.zh: Ami 没有参与这件事，Ayane。她从来都没有。

lines.en: scene onabus38
: ...Yeah.
lines.zh: ……是啊。

lines.en: : Right.
lines.zh: 对。

lines.en: : She’s just one more unfortunate victim of whatever is going on here.
lines.zh: 她只是又一个不幸的受害者，不管这里正在发生什么。

lines.en: : That said, maybe...{i}talking{/i} to Maya on a more serious level might not be all that dangerous. Like...something as simple as just having her around for your latest slumber party.
lines.zh: 话虽如此，也许……跟 Maya 更{i}认真{/i}地谈一谈，并不会有那么危险。比如……简单到只是让她来参加你最新的睡衣派对。

lines.en: : Sure...but when I’ve tried talking to her in the past-
lines.zh: 当然……但我以前试着跟她谈的时候-

lines.en: : She’s more serious about learning now. This isn’t like how it was when she first got here and didn’t believe {i}anything.{/i}
lines.zh: 她现在对了解真相更上心了。这不像她刚来的时候，{i}什么{/i}都不信。

lines.en: : Sure. But she’s only like that because she thinks it’ll help her get closer to you.
lines.zh: 当然。但她会这样，只是因为她觉得这能帮她更接近你。

lines.en: : Well...is that really such a bad thing? Tons of girls here base a bunch of their decisions on what it means for their relationship with me.
lines.zh: 嗯……那真的是件坏事吗？这里有很多女孩，做决定时都会考虑这对她和我的关系意味着什么。

lines.en: : Yeah, but none of them are Maya.
lines.zh: 是啊，可她们都不是 Maya。

lines.en: : Well, {i}Maya{/i} isn’t Maya either. So that doesn’t-
lines.zh: 嗯，{i}这个 Maya{/i}也不是 Maya。所以那并不-

lines.en: : How many more times do you think you’ll be able to tell yourself that and still believe it?
lines.zh: 你觉得你还能这样对自己说多少次，并且依然相信它？

lines.en: : Sorry, I...
lines.zh: 抱歉，我……

lines.en: scene onabus39
: We can invite Maya to the slumber party...but under {i}one{/i} condition.
lines.zh: 我们可以邀请 Maya 来睡衣派对……但有{i}一个{/i}条件。

lines.en: : That...condition being?
lines.zh: 那个……条件是？

lines.en: : You give me just as much attention.
lines.zh: 你给我同样多的关注。

lines.en: : Ayane-
lines.zh: Ayane-

lines.en: : I’m serious, Sensei. And I will spare you the details, but it feels very bad watching you fawn over a doppelganger instead of your future wife. So all I ask is you pay just as much attention to me.
lines.zh: 我是认真的，Sensei。细节我就不说了，但看着你对着一个替身献殷勤、而不是对你的未来妻子，感觉非常糟。所以我只要求你同样多地关注我。

lines.en: : Is that selfish? Yes. But that sort of thing is becoming necessary now — and this is me formally asking for a love allowance.
lines.zh: 这很自私吗？是的。但这种事现在变得必要了——而我这是在正式向你申请一份「恋爱津贴」。

lines.en: : A...love allowance.
lines.zh: 一份……恋爱津贴。

lines.en: : That’s right. For the infinite future, you will fulfill my weekly love quota.
lines.zh: 没错。在无限的未来里，你要完成我每周的恋爱配额。

lines.en: : And in return — you will receive everything you have ever wanted and more.
lines.zh: 而作为回报——你将得到你曾想要的一切，甚至更多。

lines.en: scene black
: But something tells me that still won’t be enough...
lines.zh: 但有种感觉告诉我，那依然不够……

lines.en: Ayane rests her head on my shoulder and closes her eyes before I have a chance to respond, but I have no problem giving her what she wants.
lines.zh: Ayane 把头靠在我肩上、闭上了眼睛，我还没来得及回应，但我给她想要的东西毫无问题。

lines.en: But that’s only because she wants so little.
lines.zh: 不过那只是因为她想要的太少了。

lines.en: And what {i}I{/i} want is exactly as she says.
lines.zh: 而{i}我{/i}想要的，正如她所说。

lines.en: It’s bigger than you. It’s bigger than me.
lines.zh: 它比你大。比我大。

lines.en: It’s bigger than {i}everything.{/i}
lines.zh: 它比{i}一切{/i}都大。

lines.en: And it’s because of this that I will remain forever unsatisfied.
lines.zh: 也正因如此，我将永远无法满足。

$ ayane_love += 1
{i}Ayane’s affection has increased to [ayane_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Ayane 的好感度提升到了 [ayane_love]!{/i}
